news.title: Jamie Dimon says Iran war makes Middle East peace prospects better in the long term
news.description: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon issued an optimistic viewpoint on Middle East peace, weeks into the war with Iran.

news.title: Kuwait says Strait of Hormuz closure is beyond catastrophic, will trigger domino effect across global economy
news.description: Iran is holding the world economy hostage by blockading the Strait of Hormuz, said Shaikh Nawaf Al-Sabah, the CEO of Kuwait Petroleum Corporation.

news.title: Pakistan offers to facilitate U.S.-Iran war talks as Trump and Tehran give mixed signals
news.description: Trump said top U.S. negotiators and their Iranian counterparts have been engaged in "very, very strong talks," but Tehran has denied that claim.

news.title: Arm releases first in-house chip, with Meta as debut customer
news.description: Arm is making its first CPU, pivoting from only licensing its architecture to giants like Apple, Nvidia, Amazon and Google. CNBC got an exclusive first look.

news.title: Senate, White House start to coalesce around ending DHS shutdown amid TSA delays
news.description: The Department of Homeland Security has been shut down since February over Democratic concerns about its immigration enforcement policies.

news.title: Iran war has altered the global natural gas market. Goldman says these 3 stocks will benefit
news.description: Liquid natural gas plays are set to win thanks to constrained supply, even if demand eases due to higher prices.

news.title: Stagflation alarm bells ring in the euro zone as energy crunch hits the global economy
news.description: Economists warn stagflation — high inflation and stalling growth — is facing the region because of the Iran war.

news.title: Micron stock sinks for a fourth straight day despite dominant earnings report
news.description: Micron's revenue almost tripled in the last quarter, but the memory company's stock has sunk about 15% since reporting earnings on Wednesday.

news.title: Dimon warns on AI job losses, calls for government-business incentives
news.description: The potential AI-related disruption of the job market is a critical issue in Washington, with lawmakers trying to curb the amount of job displacement.

news.title: Delta suspends 'specialty services' perk for members of Congress, cites DHS shutdown
news.description: Delta Air Lines' move comes as airports around the U.S. are seeing extra-long security lines as a result of elevated absences by TSA agents.

news.title: Pentagon ban of Anthropic faces judge; Claude AI maker seeks injunction
news.description: The Defense Department designated Anthropic as a risk to U.S. national security, the first time an American company had been hit with that designation.

news.title: Home flippers see smallest profits since the Great Recession, real estate data firm says
news.description: The typical home flip netted investors just $65,981 in gross profit last year, or a 25.5% return on investment, according to real estate data provider ATTOM.

news.title: White House to pay TotalEnergies $1 billion to kill off East Coast wind farm projects
news.description: The announcement comes as the Iran war disrupts global oil and gas supplies, making the U.S.' development of its LNG resources more urgent.

news.title: Elizabeth Warren demands answers on costs, economic impact of 'illegal and reckless war'
news.description: The liberal Democratic firebrand ripped President Donald Trump, whom she said has 'dragged the United States into an illegal and reckless war.'

news.title: Traders now see little chance of an interest rate cut this year following Fed decision
news.description: All of the positive economic talk out of this week's Federal Reserve meeting had a negative impact on investors

news.title: European Central Bank holds rates steady, warns outlook is 'significantly more uncertain'
news.description: The war in Iran has upset the economic equilibrium Europe threatening energy supplies, growth and the outlook for consumer prices, upsetting economic forecasts.

news.title: Wholesale prices rose 0.7% in February, much more than expected and up 3.4% annually
news.description: Wholesale prices rose sharply in February, providing another sign that inflation continues to percolate even aside from rising energy prices.

news.title: Bessent says Treasury is not intervening in oil commodities markets and has no authority to do so
news.description: Bessent addressed rumors that the Treasury Department or some other arm of government might step in to try to lower oil prices.

news.title: OpenAI revamps shopping experience in ChatGPT after struggling with Instant Checkout offering
news.description: OpenAI said the new experience will make it easier for users to find and compare products.

news.title: We're buying more of this cybersecurity stock as the market keeps getting it wrong
news.description: We've repeatedly pointed out that we do not think AI will disintermediate traditional cybersecurity vendors.

news.title: Circle heads for it worst day on record as proposed law could limit stablecoin yield
news.description: Earning yield, usually in the form of rewards, on stablecoins like Circle's USDC and others is key incentive for users to hold the coins.

news.title: Oklahoma’s governor picks energy executive Alan Armstrong to fill U.S. Senate seat through end of year
news.description: The choice elevates the chairman and former CEO of Williams Companies, a major pipeline operator based in Tulsa, to the Senate.

news.title: DCCC launches geotargeted digital ad campaign hitting GOP for gas prices
news.description: Democrats have seized on the economic disruption of the Iran war to hammer Republicans over high costs ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
